title: SunRey validator operator infrastructure, sentry topology, and secure node operations
notes: IMPLEMENTED at packages/sunrey-chain/src/ops and packages/sunrey-chain/node/src/ops.rs. Completes the remote signer, sentry topology, double-sign backup, operator CLI, snapshots, state sync, and governed rolling upgrades. Does not reimplement consensus or the validator registry.
